article_blocks.text: Strain Type: Indica-leaning hybrid
Genetics: Sour Best Shit Ever × Apples & Bananas × Blue Lobster
Breeder: Maine Trees
THC Content: 19–25%
CBD Content: 0.1%
Terpene Profile: limonene , linalool , myrcene
Primary Flavors: Diesel, sour citrus, pine, candy, herbs
Flowering Time (Indoor): 8–10 weeks
Outdoor Harvest Time: late September through October
Indoor Yield: Medium
Outdoor Yield: Medium to high
Grow Difficulty: Moderate

Lobster OG sounds as though it should be another maritime-themed novelty, but the flower tells a considerably more serious story. Maine Trees took the already celebrated Blue Lobster and crossed it into a pungent combination of Sour Best Shit Ever and Apples & Bananas, producing a cannabis hybrid where visual polish meets decidedly old-school gas. The buds can carry the dark coloration and extravagant frost associated with Blue Lobster, yet the aroma moves away from pure fruit and toward gasoline, pine, sour citrus, herbs, and a lingering earthy funk. It is that contrast that gives the cultivar its identity. Rather than simply making Blue Lobster sweeter or more colorful, Maine Trees pushed the genetics toward sharper, louder marijuana with enough OG-style character to justify the name.
Genetics and Lineage

Maine Trees created Lobster OG from a cross of Sour Best Shit Ever × Apples & Bananas and its award-winning Blue Lobster selection. High Times documented the exact formula when highlighting this cannabis strain in June 2026, while Maine Trees flower sold through The Flowery carries the same breeder-listed pedigree. The cross is especially interesting because Apples & Bananas appears on both sides of the extended family tree, giving the cultivar a concentrated dose of those genetics while introducing very different influences through Sour Best Shit Ever and Eye Candy.

Blue Lobster is itself a selected phenotype of Compound Genetics ‘ Façade, bred from Apples & Bananas × Eye Candy. Compound Genetics confirms that Façade produced the famous Blue Lobster phenotype, while Eye Candy contributes Biscotti and The Menthol ancestry. Blue Lobster became one of Maine’s most celebrated modern cannabis selections after earning Gassiest, Best Terps, and second place overall at the 2023 East Coast Zalympix. That parent contributes extraordinary trichome coverage, dark color, sweet fruit, and the premium bag appeal that is immediately visible in Lobster OG.

Sour Best Shit Ever pushes the family tree in a much rougher direction. That strain traces to OG LA Affie × SAGE , bringing old Kush, pine, fuel, herbs, and Haze -related complexity into the mix. Instead of the finished hybrid leaning heavily toward Apples & Bananas—as Maine Trees initially expected during the hunt—the selected Lobster OG phenotype favored the gassier SBSE side. That outcome is central to the cultivar’s personality: Blue Lobster supplies the visual glamour, while Sour Best Shit Ever injects the aggressive fuel character.
Effects and Experience

The effects tend to build in layers rather than producing one immediate sensation. Early on, there can be a pleasant upward shift in mood accompanied by a clearer, more engaged mental state. Music, conversation, gaming, or a movie may become easier to sink into, while the initial physical effect remains comparatively restrained. That cerebral brightness prevents the cultivar from feeling like an old-fashioned knockout indica during the first part of the experience.

Relaxation becomes more noticeable as time passes. The shoulders and limbs can feel heavier while mental urgency fades, turning the brighter opening into a slower, more comfortable state. This progression fits the combination of Blue Lobster’s euphoric character with the heavier OG LA Affie influence carried through Sour Best Shit Ever. Moderate servings may remain functional for experienced consumers, whereas larger amounts push much more strongly toward an evening-oriented marijuana experience.

Recent commercial batches illustrate that potency can vary. Maine Trees Lobster OG sold through The Flowery has tested around 19–23% THC, while an independent 2026 laboratory sample reached approximately 25% total THC. Those numbers put the strain firmly in potent territory without making extreme potency its defining feature. Excessive intake can still cause dry mouth, dry eyes, dizziness, short-term memory impairment, anxiety, or heavier sedation than expected.
Medical Benefits

For some medical marijuana consumers, the cultivar’s combination of mental uplift and later physical calm may be more useful than an immediately sedating strain. The earlier portion of the experience can temporarily make everyday stress feel less demanding, while the later relaxation may appeal to people who already use cannabis to unwind after physical exertion or periods of tension.

THC-rich weed is also used by some patients for appetite stimulation, nausea, discomfort, and difficulty settling down at night. Lobster OG may move toward these effects as the dose increases, particularly once the initial cerebral phase begins giving way to body relaxation.

These potential uses remain experiential rather than proven medical properties of this particular cultivar. Lobster OG has not been studied in controlled clinical trials as a treatment for anxiety, insomnia, chronic pain, depression, or other disorders. Medical consumers should rely on laboratory results from the actual batch and speak with a qualified healthcare professional when using cannabis alongside prescription medications or for significant health conditions.
Flavor Profile and Aroma

Gas is the defining feature of the selected Lobster OG phenotype. Maine Trees expected more Apples & Bananas influence during the hunt but instead found a plant leaning strongly toward Sour Best Shit Ever. Fresh flower can release diesel, sour fuel, pine resin, and earthy herbs before sweeter citrus and candy notes emerge underneath. The result smells much less like a conventional modern fruit hybrid than the presence of Blue Lobster might suggest.

On the inhale, citrus and sweet fruit often soften the first contact. Pine and herbal notes begin filling in through the middle, followed by a heavier diesel character on the exhale. Certain batches reveal more candy sweetness, while others lean firmly toward sour gas. That harvest-to-harvest variation is visible in current terpene testing as well.

Recent Maine Trees batches have listed limonene, linalool, myrcene, and beta-caryophyllene among prominent terpenes. Limonene corresponds with the sour citrus edge, while myrcene reinforces earthy and musky qualities. Linalool can contribute softer floral dimensions, and caryophyllene adds peppery spice. One current batch measured 2.05% total terpenes, while another reached 2.38%, illustrating that well-grown examples can carry a substantial aromatic load.
Growing Information

Maine Trees has not published a detailed home-grow specification for Lobster OG, so flowering times and yield figures should be presented cautiously. Available cultivation references generally place the plant at roughly eight to ten weeks of flowering, but that range is better treated as a working estimate than an official breeder promise. Its parentage suggests a medium-sized hybrid with considerably more manageable structure than a long-flowering Haze.

The flowers themselves are dense, resin-rich, and capable of developing dark green to violet coloration beneath a heavy frost of trichomes. That morphology makes airflow important during late bloom, particularly in humid environments. Closely packed cannabis flowers can retain moisture internally, so a crowded canopy or wet autumn weather can create problems before full maturity.

Yield appears to fall in the medium range rather than representing the cultivar’s central selling point. Resin quality, bag appeal, aroma, and potency received much more attention during the selection process. Outdoors, a conventional eight-to-ten-week flowering cycle would generally place harvest from late September through October in suitable Northern Hemisphere climates. Until Maine Trees releases detailed cultivation data, precise yield and outdoor-harvest claims should remain conservative.
FAQ
What are the genetics of Lobster OG?

Lobster OG is (Sour Best Shit Ever × Apples & Bananas) × Blue Lobster. Maine Trees created the cultivar, and the lineage has been independently documented by High Times and confirmed in current Maine Trees commercial flower listings.
Is Lobster OG indica or sativa?

Commercial releases generally classify Lobster OG as indica or indica-leaning. Its effects are somewhat more balanced than that label implies, with an initially euphoric and mentally engaging phase followed by steadily increasing physical relaxation.
How strong is Lobster OG weed?

Recent commercial batches have tested from roughly 19% to 23% THC, while independent 2026 laboratory testing has documented examples around 25% total THC. Actual potency depends on cultivation and harvest, so the laboratory label on the specific product is the best guide.
What does Lobster OG taste like?

Diesel and sour gas provide the strongest identity, accompanied by pine, citrus, sweet fruit, herbs, earth, and candy. The selected Maine Trees phenotype leaned much more heavily toward the Sour Best Shit Ever parent than the breeders originally expected.
Is Lobster OG related to Blue Lobster?

Yes. Blue Lobster is one of its direct parents. Blue Lobster is Maine Trees’ famous selection from Compound Genetics’ Façade, which comes from Apples & Bananas × Eye Candy. Lobster OG combines that award-winning flower with Sour Best Shit Ever × Apples & Bananas.
Final Thoughts on Lobster OG

Lobster OG works because Maine Trees did not merely repeat the qualities that made Blue Lobster famous. Blue Lobster supplies elite appearance, resin, sweet fruit, and award-winning terpene potential, but Sour Best Shit Ever redirects the offspring toward diesel, pine, earth, and old-school Kush pungency. Apples & Bananas appears throughout the extended pedigree, yet the selected plant unexpectedly favors the gassier side of the family.

That balance gives the cultivar relevance beyond novelty. It combines contemporary bag appeal with a flavor profile that deliberately moves back toward fuel-heavy marijuana, while the effects progress from pleasant cerebral elevation into deeper physical relaxation. For cannabis enthusiasts who admire Blue Lobster but want more sour gas, pine, OG character, and bite, Lobster OG represents a particularly interesting next chapter in Maine Trees’ breeding work.
